card.name: Verbs of speaking or acting after a subject
card.fires_on: Bare action verbs, often speech verbs like speak, talk, shout, find, write, right after a person or group subject or after "to". Typical in general web prose about people or students.

modes.label: Speech verbs
modes.description: Verbs of speaking or shouting following "to", "who" or "by".

modes.label: Other action verbs after a group subject
modes.description: Plain verbs following "they", "we" or "students" that describe what people do.
modes.example: "We don't really understand how they<< find>> their way."

card.writes: It favors possessives like His and Their and suppresses object pronouns like them, so the next word is likelier to be a possessive than an object.
card.plain: It fires on a verb right after a person or group, where a possessive like "their" often comes next.
